assessments.name: Assessment 1: Participation and contribution
assessments.description: Participation and contribution to class discussions, particularly in tutorials. Student are tasked with preparing and sharing in the tutorials. Students may be asked to lead discussion or critically evaluate peer comments.

assessments.name: Assessment 2: Cities as Ecosystems
assessments.description: This assessment requires students to investigate a place and record ecosystem services at scale. Using literature, maps and photos, students will describe what the observe.

assessments.name: Assessment 3: Future proofing urban strategies
assessments.description: Design and plan to future proof contemporary strategic plans to ensure resilient, healthy and flourishing urban ecologies.
